question: Who was the author of literary work 'Mricchakatika'?
solution:
The correct answer is __Shudraka.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Mṛcchakatika is a Sanskrit drama written by Shudraka.__
 
• Mṛcchakatika is written in Sanskrit in the 2nd century BCE.
 
• It is is a love story of a worthy Brahmana Charudatta and a courtesan Vasantasena.
 
• No historical records mention a king by the name Shudraka.
 
• Other notable works of Shudraka are:
 __
 
• Vinavasavadatta.
 
• Bhana.
 
• Padmaprabhritaka.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chanakya**

 
 
• Known as the mastermind behind the rise of the Maurya Empire under Chandragupta Maurya.
 
• His treatise, Arthashastra, is a comprehensive guide to statecraft, economics, and military strategy.
 
 
 
• **Kalidasa**
 
 
• Regarded as one of the greatest Sanskrit poets and dramatists.
 
• His works, including "Shakuntala", "Abhijnana Shakuntalam", and "Meghduta", are celebrated for their poetic beauty and deep understanding of human emotions.
 
 
 
• **Shri Harsha**
 
 
• Known for his contributions to Indian philosophy, particularly Advaita Vedanta.
 
• This philosophical work critiques the epistemology of the Nyaya school and rational inquiry in general.
